title: Rigidity of natural sections of constant commutative ring sheaves
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site in universe $u$ and $U$ an object of $C$. For each commutative ring $A$ in universe $u$, let $\underline A$ be its constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and let $\eta_A:A\to\underline A(U)$ be the component of the constant-presheaf sheafification unit. Suppose that ring homomorphisms $\alpha_A:A\to\underline A(U)$ are natural in every commutative ring: for each ring homomorphism $f:A\to B$, one has $\alpha_B\circ f=\underline f(U)\circ\alpha_A$. Then $\alpha_A=\eta_A$ for every $A$.

source.place: Proposition functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi (Tag 00YV), supplemented by the universal-polynomial normalization argument written in Step 2 of lem-sf-constant-inverse-image-scalar-normalization.

proof.text: Take Z=ULift of the integers and P=Z[X]. The Z component is the canonical unit by initiality. Use local surjectivity of the sheafification unit to represent alpha_P(X), on a covering sieve of U, by polynomials p.

For each such p not equal to X, Polynomial.funext gives an integer n with p(n) not n. Naturality for evaluation at n gives equality of those two distinct constant integer sections. Local injectivity of sheafification gives an empty covering sieve on this piece, so separatedness of any sheaf identifies all its sections there. Thus alpha_P(X) equals the constant X on every piece; separatedness gives the equality over U.

For any a in A, apply naturality to the polynomial ring map P to A sending X to a. The equality already proved for X and naturality of the sheafification unit imply alpha_A(a)=eta_A(a). Extensionality proves equality of ring homomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem constantRingSectionRigidity {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (α : ∀ A : CommRingCat.{u},
      A ⟶ ((constantSheaf J CommRingCat.{u}).obj A).obj.obj U)
    (hα : ∀ {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B),
      f ≫ α B = α A ≫ ((constantSheaf J CommRingCat).map f).hom.app U)
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) :
    α A = (toSheafify J ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj A)).app U
